_comment: ARMOURED kit: the applique tile grid - reactive armour bolted over the plate, and the kit's second thin-shape carrier after the cap. Four raised tiles on a dark backing with the shadow gap between them doing all the drawing, 0.04 cells proud: the flush hatch's trick (the gap reads, not the plate) repeated four up, so it stays legible at range without breaking the silhouette. Nothing sits at the grid's centre - the detail IS the edges between the tiles.
